# NanhaCare

> NanhaCare connects families in Pakistan with trusted, verified babysitters, curated baby & kids products, and free parenting resources. Every caregiver passes CNIC verification, police clearance, an in-person interview, and childcare training.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://rutaabali3.github.io/nanha.care.co/): Service overview, verification process, and featured caregivers
- [Find Babysitters](https://rutaabali3.github.io/nanha.care.co/babysitters.html): Directory of 21 verified babysitters across Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad with ratings and hourly rates (Rs 350-500)
- [Products](https://rutaabali3.github.io/nanha.care.co/products.html): Curated newborn, toddler, preschool, and school-age essentials with Pakistan-friendly prices and retailer links
- [Parenting Blog](https://rutaabali3.github.io/nanha.care.co/blog.html): 40 free guides and downloadable PDF resources (sleep routines, diapering, vaccination schedules, postpartum care, milestones)
- [Babysitter Training](https://rutaabali3.github.io/nanha.care.co/training.html): NanhaCare certification training program for caregivers
- [Become a Babysitter](https://rutaabali3.github.io/nanha.care.co/enroll.html): Caregiver enrollment and verification pathway
- [Pricing](https://rutaabali3.github.io/nanha.care.co/pricing.html): Basic, Premium, and Elite membership plans for families
- [FAQs](https://rutaabali3.github.io/nanha.care.co/faq.html): Verification, booking, refund, and emergency-support questions
- [About](https://rutaabali3.github.io/nanha.care.co/about.html): Company mission and safety commitments
